headline: Quarterback injuries drive the NFL board (Lamar Jackson's ankle MRI Monday, Washington's QB room), Cincinnati has lost both Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, the Division Series pitching is elite and low-scoring, and Georgia at Alabama and Texas vs. Oklahoma headline college Saturday.
label: Oct 5 – 11, 2026

items: Heisman odds: Jeremiah Smith (Ohio State WR) +115, Darian Mensah (Miami QB) +460, Keelon Russell (Alabama QB) +750, CJ Carr (Notre Dame QB) +800.
Miami and Ohio State have byes on Oct 10, so there are no Smith or Mensah props this week.
Russell threw for 285 and accounted for 4 TDs vs. Mississippi State; now draws Georgia's defense.
No. 1 Texas (4-0): Arch Manning has thrown an INT in 3 of 4 games and taken 10 sacks.
Oregon QB Dante Moore is in concussion protocol; Dylan Raiola went 19-for-25 with 2 TDs in relief. Oregon is -12.5 vs. UCLA (total 58.5).
UCLA RB Wayne Knight has 445 rushing yards and 9 rushing TDs.
cfb.summary: Week 7 lands Saturday, Oct 10. Georgia at Alabama, Texas vs. Oklahoma, UCLA at Oregon and USC at Penn State are the headliners. Miami and Ohio State are both idle.

items: Rays 1, Yankees 0: Drew Rasmussen took a no-hitter into the 8th.
White Sox 3, Guardians 0; Brewers 3, Padres 2; Dodgers 5, Braves 3.
ALDS Game 2 (Mon): Cam Schlittler (NYY, 1.95 ERA) vs. Freddy Peralta (TB, 0.96 ERA in September).
ALDS Game 2 (Mon): Gavin Williams (CLE, 248 K, 11 double-digit K games) vs. Anthony Kay (CWS) as an opener.
Aaron Judge (NYY) was left off the ALDS roster on Oct 3 while he recovers from a calf injury.
mlb.summary: Division Series under way. Game 1s were tight and pitcher-driven.

items: Prop picks start the week of Oct 19 once regular-season lines post.
nba.summary: Preseason. Opening night is Tuesday, Oct 20: Celtics at Pistons, 76ers at Knicks (banner night), Thunder at Spurs.

items: Lamar Jackson (BAL) left Week 4 in a walking boot and has an ankle MRI Monday. Tyler Huntley went 8-of-9 in relief. Baltimore visits Atlanta Sunday night.
Bengals: Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (groin/adductor strain, possibly 2–3 weeks; had 11 catches for 157 yds first) both left the 22-17 loss to Jacksonville.
Washington: Dan Quinn says 'the hope' is Jayden Daniels (elbow) returns in Week 5; Marcus Mariota aggravated his MCL, and rookie Athan Kaliakmanis finished in London.
Justin Jefferson (MIN, ankle sprain) missed Week 4 but the Vikings are hopeful he plays at New Orleans.
Saquon Barkley (PHI) hamstring, out in the first half; DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert were already out.
Chargers lost Ladd McConkey (foot), Joe Alt (neck) and Rashawn Slater (ankle). Denver lost CBs Patrick Surtain II (ankle) and Riley Moss (ribs) ahead of their meeting.
Caleb Williams (CHI) and Baker Mayfield (TB) both sat Week 4.
nfl.summary: Week 4 closes tonight with Atlanta at New Orleans. Week 5 opens Thursday with Tampa Bay at Dallas and ends Monday with Buffalo at the Rams. Carolina and Kansas City are on bye.
